verdict.rationale: Canny publishes a documented public API Reference (canny-docs-16) with a full developer docs site (canny-docs-15, canny-probe-1 llms.txt confirming developer docs), plus SDK/widget install docs and an official MCP server for LLM-driven interaction (canny-docs-3, canny-docs-9, canny-probe-3), enabling AI-native users to query and act on data programmatically. Missing for 10: an accessible OpenAPI/Swagger spec (canny-probe-2 shows all candidate OpenAPI endpoints 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.
